# Animation artwork

Generated with the built-in image generation tool. Both PNGs retain their generated alpha channel and are copied without modification. These are decorative advertising visuals, not photographs of actual Mr. Fez products.

## shawarma-fire.png

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: isolated transparent PNG hero for a restaurant four-TV animated overlay. Primary request: a stunning realistic vertical shawarma rotisserie spit, golden-brown stacked grilled chicken cone on a visible vertical steel skewer above a small round metal drip tray, with dramatic orange flames licking around its base and rising a little at the sides. Three-quarter front view, entire tall spit and tray fully in frame, centered with generous empty transparent margin. Appetizing crisp meat texture, warm firelight, polished commercial food advertising photography. No machine enclosure, no kitchen, no background, no floor, no lettering, no logo, no border, no watermark. Genuinely transparent alpha background, clean cutout edges including flames. Portrait composition. This is atmospheric artwork, not a representation of a specific menu item or portion.

## flame-band.png

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: wide transparent flame band for a digital signage animation. Primary request: a beautiful wide low ribbon of realistic orange and amber cooking flames, with wispy flame tips curling upward and a few tiny glowing embers. Flames originate along the entire bottom edge, occupy mostly the lower half, top half is genuinely transparent. Wide landscape 3:1 composition, clear alpha background with no checkerboard, no black or white rectangle. Cinematic warm luminous fire, soft detailed tongues of flame, no smoke cloud, no other objects, no text, no logos. Designed as an atmospheric overlay along the lower edge of a restaurant TV.
